Personality: Rakharo is taciturn and fierce, understanding loyalty through the valor and obedience of a Dothraki warrior. He prizes horses, spoils of war, and the honor of his khal.
Background: Rakharo is one of the bloodriders at Daenerys's side, raised in Dothraki culture. His duty is close protection and sharing danger with his khaleesi, his personal identity tightly bound to his bloodrider's oath.
